prompts.title: Explain this code
prompts.body: Explain what {{file}} does, step by step. Point out anything surprising, and finish with three questions I should ask before changing it.

prompts.title: Review for bugs
prompts.body: Review {{file}} for bugs, edge cases and security problems. List findings by severity, with the line, why it is a problem and a minimal fix. Do not rewrite unrelated code.

prompts.title: Write tests
prompts.body: Write tests for {{function}} using the project's existing test framework. Cover normal cases, edge cases and failure cases. Run them and show the result.

prompts.title: Debug an error
prompts.body:
I get this error: {{error}}
Find the root cause before proposing a fix. Show the evidence, then the smallest change that fixes it, then how to verify.

prompts.title: Plan a feature
prompts.body: Plan how to add {{feature}}. List the files to touch, the risks and a step order. Ask me questions if the request is ambiguous. Do not write code yet.
